subject: Annual security questionnaire — 86 questions, due in 4 weeks
body:
Priya — annual SOC2 + HIPAA review on our side. Attached questionnaire. We need responses for renewal which is June. Our InfoSec lead will follow up directly with your security team.

Carlos

subject: Umbrella security questionnaire — 86 questions, June renewal
body:
Sasha — Umbrella's annual SOC2/HIPAA review. 86 questions. CIO's email + questionnaire forwarded.

Quick context: this account is $310k ARR, June renewal. This questionnaire is on the renewal critical path. Last year's took 4 weeks.

What I need from you: realistic timeline, what's reusable from our SOC2 trust center, what needs custom answers. Will route their InfoSec to you directly once the kickoff is set.

Thanks!
P

subject: Re: Umbrella security questionnaire — 86 questions, June renewal
body:
Priya — went through it. Breakdown:
- 52 reusable from trust center (we'll batch-respond)
- 22 require some custom prose but I have similar drafts
- 12 are net-new and require engineering input (mostly around the new SSO architecture and event retention)

Realistic: 5–6 weeks not 4. The 12 engineering-input ones need Yelena (SSO) and Rohan (events). I'll set kickoff with Umbrella's InfoSec for next week.

Note: question 47 on encryption-at-rest key custody will likely require a side conversation. We rotate keys but the questionnaire is asking about HSM custody specifically. Not a no, but not a quick yes either.

Sasha

title: Umbrella questionnaire — engineering review session
discussion:
Yelena drafted SSO answers (Qs 18, 24, 31, 39, 52). Solid coverage. One open: SCIM provisioning timeline question — Yelena says shipping Q1 2025, Sasha to phrase as 'on roadmap'.

Rohan went through events retention questions (Qs 41, 44, 58, 63). All answerable from ADR-0017 + retention spec. No custom dev work required.

Q47 (HSM key custody): we don't use HSM, we use AWS KMS with CMK rotation. Sasha proposed framing as 'CMK with annual rotation, FIPS 140-2 Level 3 KMS HSM-backed' — which is technically accurate per AWS KMS docs. Rohan agreed. Priya to confirm with Carlos that this framing is acceptable to their InfoSec.
decisions: Q47 to be answered with AWS KMS framing — Priya pre-aligns with Carlos before final submission

subject: Security questionnaire — full response attached
body:
Hi Carlos,

Full response attached, 7 weeks total — slightly over the 4 you scoped because the engineering-specific questions on SSO architecture and key custody warranted careful answers rather than fast ones. Sasha is the right contact for any followup from your InfoSec side.

One question worth flagging directly: Q47 on key custody. We answered with the AWS KMS HSM-backed framing we discussed last month. If your InfoSec wants additional detail on rotation cadence, custody chain, or audit access, Sasha can do a 30-min walkthrough.

Looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Priya

subject: Re: Security questionnaire — closing out
body:
Priya — InfoSec has signed off. Renewal review now back to operational track. Thanks for the patience and detail on Q47 — that was the right level of care.

See you on the November QBR.

Carlos

subject: Renewal proposal — 24-month with EHR roadmap commit
body:
Hi Carlos, Anita,

Proposal attached. Headline: 24-month renewal at $310k/year (no increase), with co-development commitment on the EHR integration that's been blocking pop-health workflow expansion.

Why 24-month: gives us both runway to ship the EHR integration (currently scoped for Q1 2026) and reduces the security-questionnaire cadence from annual to biennial under our trust framework.

Happy to walk through. Anita, would value 30 min of your time on the clinical-impact side of pop-health expansion separately.

Best,
Priya
